### About Us
Terrestrial ecosystems such as forests and meadows are known for high biodiversity and the ability to sequester carbon dioxide. Seaweeds and seagrasses create similar ecosystems in the marine environment.

At the Laboratory of Aquatic Plant Ecology, we are interested in studying ecosystems created by seaweeds and seagrasses from both an applied and basic science perspective.
